answer: A hostile operator hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 48 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The vault counter is kept in sparrow and fable shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 48 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 2 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
